notes.title: Virtual Driving School Developer Demo
notes.notes:
A live snapshot of the game to discuss where we are at and what we are going to do next with Virtual Driving School.  We will talk about current features and our roadmap for developing a full product.

We will school the current progress and it is an opportunity to talk about what features you would like to see in the final product.

Currently we are still in Alpha and our trying to get to a point where we can release as Early Access, most of the core driving tech is done we are currently creating learning content and the tools to make more content.

This will include the ability to make your own lessons and share them with your friends.

notes.title: Demo updated with VR support
notes.notes:
[b]'And for your next test... lets put the car into VR!’ [/b] [b]CGA Studio keeps drivers on their toes by releasing Virtual Driving School in VR. [/b]

[u][b]STEP 1 Find your Keys.[/b]  [/u]

Just like in the real world, your first task is to find your keys! 

Are they behind the mirror or have they fell on the floor?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823860/53ce28bf8692257ff687f8bcce526f2684fc26d0.gif[/img]

So, got your keys? Ready to cross the next hurdle on the road to driving perfection? 

Right, here goes...

[u][b]STEP 2 Start the Car.[/b] [/u]

Put the keys into the ignition on the right-hand side of the steering wheel base and when you let go of the keys they should stay there. 

Turn the key away from you (clockwise) to start the ignition on the car. 

The revs meter should spring up and the engine should start. 

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/GentleTemptingJay-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[u][b]STEP 3 Car Controls.[/b] [/u]

We’re away! 

No hold on, not so fast. 

It’s time to learn about the[b] car controls. [/b]Sounds dull but you won’t get far without the basics, will you? 

Just like in a real car, you use the [b]steering wheel, handbrake, pedals and gear shifter[/b]; using the [b]indicator stem[/b] to control the car’s indicators. Clearly you’re not in a real car (although CGA’s created some great graphics just to for you) so you will control the pedals with the trigger on each controller (right trigger = accelerators, left trigger = brake.)

[u][b]STEP 4 Adjust your Mirrors![/b] [/u]

You can use the [b]three mirrors [/b]in the car to see your surroundings: two side mirrors and one rearview mirror. 

You can grab hold of the mirrors and move them about; point them in whatever direction gives you the best view of the road around you. 

The side mirrors can also be adjusted with the analog sticks on the left controller.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HarmoniousVapidBushbaby-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[u][b]STEP 5 Pedal to the metal![/b] [/u]

Yes, you’re ready to drive now. Accelerate away by pulling the right trigger. 

Grab the handbrake in the car, using the grip button to grab, and move your hand down while holding the grab button to lower the handbrake. 

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DiscreteWetArgentineruddyduck-size_restricted.gif[/img]

You’re a natural! 

... Well, you are if the handbrake icon has turned itself off. If not, try again, you’ll get there. 

With the handbrake off you should be ready to go, if you are holding down the accelerator you should be moving forward. 

Continue steering the car by grabbing the steering wheel with your hands. 

Enjoy the ride and good luck!

notes.title: Virtual Driving School: FREE DEMO
notes.notes:
Fancy testing a new driving skills game? Join us at Steam’s Next Fest festival, 2021, to test your driving ability in a ‘Sim City’ style simulation.  

Buckle up and check your mirrors! We are launching a [b]free demo[/b] of ‘Virtual Driving School’ on the [b]18th of June[/b].

Calling all testers and ‘bug busters’ to trial the first early access version of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39823860/5cd80a1d1dce674bd5a9a26af1a1bb18f80f2697.png[/img] 

Our aim is to create a serious, skills-based game that gives players tips on how to become safer drivers, in a hyper-real, virtual environment. Modeled around a ‘Sim City’- style simulated world, you can visit city streets and highways. A wide range of unique driving challenges and scenarios require precision and concentration. It’s an exciting ride!

We look forward to hearing your honest feedback and any ideas you have for the future development of the game. 

Please follow us on[b] Twitter @CGA_Studio_[/b]

P.S Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
